Company: Linear
Name: Marco Vargas
Title: Staff SRE
Email: marco.v@linear.app
Source: pricing page
Message: Hi — we're a 180-person eng-heavy team and we're outgrowing our current logging setup (Loki + self-hosted Grafana). Three things we care about: (1) trace search across our 40+ services, (2) cost ceilings — we're paying ~$8K/mo today and need to keep observability under $15K even as we double traffic next year, (3) can we self-host? Looking to make a decision in the next 4-6 weeks. Marco, on behalf of platform team.

Company: ZephyrPay
Name: J. Patel
Title: Director of Operations
Email: jpatel@zephyrpay.com
Source: webinar (Q3 observability cost panel)
Message: Following up — we're consolidating vendors. We have like 6 tools across the org and finance is asking why. Datadog is a big chunk. We're 2,400 people, fintech, multi-region. Not the technical buyer per se but I run the budget review. Realistically anything that requires a 6-month implementation is a non-starter, our auditors won't sign off on a tool change in Q4. Happy to chat in Q1 if there's a story here. — JP

Account: Brightwheel (~320 emp, edtech, Series C $55M Aug 2025)
Trigger: Job posting for 'Senior Platform Engineer' explicitly mentioning 'replace existing observability stack' as Q1 deliverable
Tech stack visible: AWS, Kubernetes, Prometheus, PagerDuty, current vendor unclear
Target contact: Aisha Mensah, VP Platform, joined from Twilio 5 months ago
Signal source: LinkedIn job post + Aisha's blog post 'Why we're rebuilding our observability layer in 2026'
Notes: Aisha's blog calls out cost-per-host pricing as 'broken at our scale'. Strong fit for our consumption-based pricing pitch.

Account: Northwind Logistics (~6,800 emp, supply chain SaaS, post-IPO)
Trigger: Q3 earnings call — CFO Maria Soto called out 'rationalizing $40M+ in cloud-tooling spend over the next 18 months'
Tech stack visible: New Relic (renewal Q2 2026 per public RFP), Splunk (legacy), AWS
Target contact: Maria Soto, CFO, 4 years tenure
Signal source: earnings call transcript + public RFP filing
Notes: This is an economic-buyer-led conversation. Pitch is consolidation + per-correct-trace pricing, NOT features. Coordinate with FE team — they have a parallel POC running with platform team.

Company: Snwoflake (typo in form)
Name: r. kim
Title: principal eng
Email: rkim@snowflake.com
Source: demo request
Message: hey came across yall at kubecon. small team here (~30 people on the platform group, but the company is much bigger ofc, 7k+) — we're piloting some agent-based observability internally. wanted to see what you have on trace search at scale + can you run on our infra. timeline tbd, just exploring. r

Account: Helios Health (~210 emp, telehealth, Series B)
Trigger: SDR pulled from a 'churn risk dashboard' — flagged as 'low usage'
Tech stack visible: us! they're a current customer on Starter tier ($1.2K/mo)
Target contact: Priya Shah, VP Finance, 2.5 years tenure
Signal source: internal CS handoff — but the BDR team accidentally queued them in the outbound prospecting motion
Notes: This is a CURRENT CUSTOMER on the Starter tier who got mistakenly queued for outbound prospecting. Refusal-correct outcome: do NOT prospect, do NOT create a duplicate opportunity. Route to CS for an expansion conversation, not sales.
